Hi Tim,

I'm sorry. You've asked three times since October 31 and kept getting the same line back with no real update. Here's where both orders actually stand.

Order ····-A (July 31): your Magic M. 40T is paid and waiting on the factory. It comes with the Miner D. and Power K., and all three ship together in one box. We had a control board problem during the first production run. That's fixed now, and the final version is approved. All the units are built, and Magic M. expects to ship them out from the factory on November 12. We'll email you tracking as soon as your miner is on its way to you. You can follow the shipment to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

We sent you updates about this on November 3 and November 8. If you didn't get them, they may have gone to junk. Please check there and add (email hidden) and (email hidden) to your contacts.

Order ····-A (September 27): your GekkoScience KBOX was due to ship September 30, and it's late. I'm sorry about that. It hasn't arrived from the manufacturer yet, and I don't have a firm new date to give you. I won't guess one. I've asked a colleague to get you the real date, and they're picking it up today. Their answer will come to you in this thread.

Thanks for your patience, Tim.

Sarah
